main.description: Get a blob by its CID from temporary R2 storage. Returns the raw binary content. The authenticated user's temporary blob is retrieved using their DID and the provided CID.

cid.description: Content Identifier (CID) of the blob to retrieve.

errors.description: The requested blob was not found.
errors.name: BlobNotFound

errors.description: Invalid CID format or missing parameters.
errors.name: InvalidRequest
